episodes.synopsis: A mysterious and feared masked wrestler named Tiger Mask, who has already made headlines throughout the Americas for his notorious dishonesty, returns to Japan. Regarded with disfavor by the entire Japan Pro-Wrestling Association, he is immediately ostracized; the only one who seems to understand him, despite everything, is Giant Baba, a respected and extremely honest pro-wrestler. Kenta, a boy living in the Chibikko House orphanage, despite everything and everyone, shows—uniquely among the children—a tremendous admiration for Tiger Mask. The two young people who currently run this shelter for abandoned children are also former orphans, a brother and sister: Kenta reminds him strongly of their old friend Naoto Date at his age, who ran away over ten years earlier and never returned, when after a visit to the zoo, standing in front of the tiger's cage, he resolutely declared that he too wanted to one day become as strong as a tiger...
episodes.title: The Yellow Devil

episodes.synopsis: Little Kenta runs away from the orphanage to attend a match with Tiger Man, who is as ruthless as ever with his opponents.
episodes.title: Tiger the Stormbringer

episodes.synopsis: Naoto returns to the orphanage where he grew up. While in the role of the Tiger Mask, he must face Monster, the man with the steel head.
episodes.title: The Man Who Returned

episodes.synopsis: Uomo Tigre reflects on his training at the Tiger's Den, which subjected him to cruel and nearly unbearable training.
episodes.title: Law of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Mister X threatens Tigre d'Acciaio because he wants him to give him half of the money he earns from the matches at the Tiger Cage.
episodes.title: Tiger Is Ready to Die

episodes.synopsis: At the airport, a tiger escapes, but Pitone Nero, the next opponent of the Tiger Mask, stops her by rendering her docile with his charisma.
episodes.title: Terrible Death Match

episodes.synopsis: After Ruriko asks Tiger Mask to fight fairly, he wins his first match without using illegal moves.
episodes.title: The Bloodstained Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Ruriko begins to suspect that the Tiger Mask is actually Naoto, who, in the meantime, must evade the attacks of Mister X.
episodes.title: Trap of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: The gigantic Gorilla Man arrives in Japan, the next opponent of Tiger Mask sent by the Tiger Cage.
episodes.title: The Starved Gorilla Man

episodes.synopsis: Uomo Tigre is training for his next match, but Baba makes it clear that his method is wrong.
episodes.title: Fresh-Bomb Megaton Drop

episodes.synopsis: Baba tries to convince Tiger Mask to participate in the next World Tournament, but he is hesitant.
episodes.title: The Marvelous World League

episodes.synopsis: Uomo Tigre fears that he will not be able to contain his unorthodox style for the World Tournament, but he will soon change his mind.
episodes.title: For Whom He Fights?

episodes.synopsis: During the meeting with Stella di Teschio, Mister X causes a blackout in the arena to carry out another one of his evil plans.
episodes.title: The Terrible Hell Operation

episodes.synopsis: Daimon, Naoto's training partner, sends a letter to his friend from the Tiger's Den. However, Mister X gets ahold of it and uses it to blackmail him.
episodes.title: Secret Training in Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Caught up in the excitement of cheering, Kenta breaks the orphanage's television, leaving the children unable to watch the next Tiger Mask match.
episodes.title: Victory with Countless Wounds

episodes.synopsis: Stella di Teschio refuses to kill Naoto and is killed by Tana delle Tigre instead. L'Uomo Ombra doesn't want the same thing to happen to him.
episodes.title: Defeated Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Cappy is hit by a hit-and-run driver. Naoto and Kenta set out to find her.
episodes.title: Tiger Awaked

episodes.synopsis: Mister X tries to force Daimon to fight Naoto, even using torture. In the end, the man gives in and decides to face his friend in the ring.
episodes.title: The Fate Showdown

episodes.synopsis: L'Uomo Tigre decides to help a boy he just met. Will he make it back in time for his match?
episodes.title: Two Hours Till the Starting Bout

episodes.synopsis: Naoto takes the orphans to the amusement park, but he is pursued by Tana delle Tigri there as well.
episodes.title: Shadow of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Brisco had been confined to a wheelchair by Tiger Man when he was still evil. Now his brother has arrived in Japan to seek revenge.
episodes.title: The Red Fang with Revenge

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man suffers an injury during a match and should rest, but his next match is too close.
episodes.title: Challenge for Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Tana delle Tigri selects a group of masked wrestlers to send against Tiger Man.
episodes.title: Tiger Risks His Life

episodes.synopsis: Tigre decides to participate in the masked wrestlers' tournament to help the blind orphan girl. His first opponent is Mister No.
episodes.title: The Opening of the Maskmen League

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man must face two other masked wrestlers in the tournament in quick succession. The two use completely illegal tricks.
episodes.title: Deadly Battle with the Golden Mask

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious new masked wrestler joins the tournament and teams up with Tiger Man against Lion Man and the Egyptian Mummy.
episodes.title: Beyond the Glory

episodes.synopsis: With the money from the tournament, Tiger Man can finally get little Lory operated on, in the hope that she will regain her sight.
episodes.title: Open Your Eyes, Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Tana delle Tigri decides to build a new, larger, and more modern headquarters, while Mister X travels the world in search of new talent.
episodes.title: Tiger's Cave Revives

episodes.synopsis: Joe Fortis arrives in Japan to challenge Tiger Man. The new wrestler turns out to be a former coach of Naoto and Daimon.
episodes.title: Challenger Strong

episodes.synopsis: Naoto is very tense because he still can't come up with a winning move. Master Arashi tells him the story of a great champion from the past.
episodes.title: The Eternal Burning Spirit: Rikidozan Story

episodes.synopsis: The Apollon brothers arrive in Japan. The younger brother is determined to challenge Tiger Man, who is training in the mountains to find his winning move.
episodes.title: So Special Training at Daisetsuzan

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man faces Ursus, the youngest of the Apollon brothers. During the match, he decides to use his new winning move.
episodes.title: His Special Attack Is Born!

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man prepares for his match against Star, but he is quite worried. The day of the match arrives, and the two fight a great battle.
episodes.title: The Marvelous Battle

episodes.synopsis: The new talents at the Tiger's Den begin training that seems very different from what Naoto did in his day.
episodes.title: A Hot-Blooded Boy in Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Tigre fears returning to his former self as an unfair fighter, so Baba decides to tell him his story and all the difficulties he had to face.
episodes.title: Road to the Champion: Giant Baba Story

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man leaves for the Asian tournament and gradually gets to know all the wrestlers who will be participating.
episodes.title: The Opening of All Asia Championship

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man's first opponent is a giant Indian wrestler who hides a disturbing secret.
episodes.title: The Yeti of Himalaya

episodes.synopsis: The Asian tournament is in full swing and every fighter is giving it their all. Tiger Man identifies Mister Ki as his most formidable opponent.
episodes.title: Tiger Who Aims at the Champion

episodes.synopsis: Mister Ki has found the winning counterattack to the "tiger's fall," and Tiger Man must find a solution quickly if he wants to win the final.
episodes.title: Victory Crown with Tears

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man returns triumphant to Japan, but he knows he will never be able to use his "tiger drop" again.
episodes.title: Triumphant Return of Tiger the Phoenix

episodes.synopsis: The "Tiger Drop" is no longer effective, and Diavolo manages to defeat Naoto. At the end of the match, a new formidable wrestler from Tiger's Den arrives.
episodes.title: The Red Death Mask

episodes.synopsis: Death Mask seems like a truly unbeatable fighter, and everyone is very concerned about Tiger Man's fate.
episodes.title: No Tomorrow for Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Death Mask proves himself to be a violent and ruthless fighter. Tiger will have to abandon his fair fighting style once again if he wants to win the match.
episodes.title: The Strongest Heel on the Earth

episodes.synopsis: Naoto returns to the United States to fight in matches, but he is deeply troubled by what he did during his match against Death Mask.
episodes.title: The Challenge from Kamikaze

episodes.synopsis: Tigre arrives in Germany to face the giant Mapman. Meanwhile, the wrestler decides to have a new mask made to replace his worn-out one.
episodes.title: A Boy with Nostalgia to Home Country

episodes.synopsis: A young French wrestler leaves the Tiger's Den to find his father. Naoto decides to help him to prevent the boy from returning to that frightening place.
episodes.title: The Secret Mission of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man must face Jungle King, a fierce fighter with mysterious powers. Tiger is warned by a previous opponent of the black fighter.
episodes.title: Verbal Warfare in the Ring

episodes.synopsis: The time has finally come for Tiger Man to face Kamikaze. Naoto has learned from previous encounters and is training to develop a new winning move.
episodes.title: The Battle with Kamikaze

episodes.synopsis: Naoto returns to Japan after his European successes. His compatriots are eager to see his new final move.
episodes.title: Tiger Mask Revives

episodes.synopsis: Tigre and other wrestlers are in Hiroshima for a series of matches. Naoto is fascinated by a model and wants to get his hands on it at all costs.
episodes.title: Give Your Affection to the Children

episodes.synopsis: Japanese wrestlers are determined to defend their colors, but foreign wrestlers use every kind of foul play to take home the victory.
episodes.title: An Eagle and a Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Mister X has something in mind regarding the tournament final between Tiger Man and Bill Hercules. What could his evil plan be?
episodes.title: Win the the World League!

episodes.synopsis: Ken continues to train at the Tiger's Den, more determined than ever to defeat Tiger Man, whom he believes is responsible for his mother's death.
episodes.title: Mystery of the Miracles

episodes.synopsis: A new girl arrives at Ruriko's orphanage. Little Micro seems rather spoiled and is unable to fit in with her new friends.
episodes.title: A New Friend

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man and other wrestlers arrive in a city submerged by pollution. An orphan protests against a company to protect the health of his friend.
episodes.title: The Sun in Soot and Smoke

episodes.synopsis: Popo Africa suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of Tiger Man when the latter was fighting as the Yellow Demon. Now he's back and swears revenge.
episodes.title: The Black Deity

episodes.synopsis: Nero V arrives in Japan determined to avenge his master Popo Africa. The fighter is very confident and immediately shows everyone his secret technique.
episodes.title: His V-Sign Calls Death In

episodes.synopsis: The eagerly awaited match between Tiger Man and Nero V is about to begin, but first Baba and Inoki must face the Miracle Brothers.
episodes.title: Black V

episodes.synopsis: Tigre arrives at the dojo of one of his instructors and a friend of Master Arashi. Here he meets a young man determined to fight him in order to pay off his accumulated debts.
episodes.title: A Reckless Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man meets a doctor on a train who is addicted to alcohol. The doctor wants to treat a boy who has been in an accident, and Naoto offers his help.
episodes.title: Tiger and a Awkward Doctor

episodes.synopsis: Rudy, a new wrestler from Tiger's Den, says he is confident he can stop Tiger Man's winning move. Meanwhile, the wrestler prevents a sculptor from committing suicide.
episodes.title: Road of "Shogi" King

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man reads in a newspaper that a wrestler has died in the ring at the hands of the mysterious Black Panther. Naoto fears that he may be his next opponent.
episodes.title: The Black Challenger

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man faces Demon, but thoughts of his upcoming opponents distract him considerably. However, an old man in the audience manages to spur him on.
episodes.title: "Meriken" Joe

episodes.synopsis: Naoto meets a young boy who is sitting alone looking sad, even though it's Christmas. The wrestler decides to follow him to find out what his problems are.
episodes.title: Till When the Fortunate Bell Rings

episodes.synopsis: Naoto meets Daimon at Master Arashi's dojo, and the two train together in preparation for Tiger's match against Black Panther.
episodes.title: Deadly Battle on the Maskmen Championship

episodes.synopsis: Naoto looks after Kenta, who is confined to bed with a fever. The child shows him an album of photographs of Tiger Man, and Naoto relives his career through those photos.
episodes.title: The Terror of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: A new wrestler has recently appeared in America who calls himself the Yellow Devil, which is the old pseudonym of Tiger Man. Naoto is impressed.
episodes.title: Resurrection of the Yellow Devil

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man investigates the identity of the Yellow Devil and begins to strongly suspect that it is Ken. If it really is him, it would be very difficult for Naoto to fight him.
episodes.title: Phantom of the Yellow Devil

episodes.synopsis: The young Junker from Tiger's Den challenges Tiger Man, disregarding the wishes of his organization. Meanwhile, the boy meets a child who is friends with Naoto.
episodes.title: The Rule-Brake Challenger

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man and Kamikaze face off once again. However, Naoto cannot come to terms with Hans' death and swears revenge against Tana delle Tigri.
episodes.title: Regret at the Ring

episodes.synopsis: Re Giaguaro, rising star of the American West, is chosen as Tiger Man's next challenger. This opponent also comes from Tiger's Den.
episodes.title: Tiger Meets the Crisis!

episodes.synopsis: Daimon finally returns to the ring wearing Mr. Fudo's mask. His strong performance wins over the hearts of fans.
episodes.title: Mr. Fudo Comes Onstage

episodes.synopsis: Yellow Devil finally manages to convince the Tiger's Den to let him meet Tiger Man. Ken is increasingly determined to avenge his mother.
episodes.title: The Trump of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Ken is kidnapped by Mr. X and Tana delle Tigri's hitmen. Daimon sets off in pursuit to save the boy's life.
episodes.title: The Traitor No.3

episodes.synopsis: Ken begins wrestling without a mask for the Japanese federation and enjoys great success. Some young people from Tana delle Tigri would like to follow his example.
episodes.title: Great Escape from Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Black Tiger and Big Tiger challenge Tiger Man and Daimon. Naoto seems quite intimidated and does not want to tell his friend the news.
episodes.title: The Phantom Wrestlers

episodes.synopsis: The day of the match against Big Tiger and Black Tiger has finally arrived. The fight is particularly violent, and all the wrestlers seem determined to fight to the death.
episodes.title: Tag Team in the Deadly Battle

episodes.synopsis: Daimon is in critical condition, and Naoto and Ken are very worried. As if that weren't enough, Naoto also has to face the Tiger King.
episodes.title: Tiger Against Tiger

episodes.synopsis: The leader of Tiger's Den is very upset after the defeat of his best fighters, so he orders Mister X to assassinate Tiger Man.
episodes.title: The Big Boss of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Ken is improving visibly, but he still can't eliminate certain incorrect moves from his repertoire. Baba decides to put his trust in him anyway.
episodes.title: A Nova Is Born

episodes.synopsis: Ken's popularity continues to grow. In his next match, he faces Black Hurricane, a very experienced and formidable wrestler.
episodes.title: The Promotor in Hell

episodes.synopsis: Mister X has chosen Maschera Universo as Tiger Man's next challenger. The wrestler has remarkable athletic skills, which he shows off in front of journalists and Ken.
episodes.title: The Deadly Battle in Cage

episodes.synopsis: Micro accompanies Ruriko to choose a wedding gift for her friend. There she meets her aunt and uncle, who recognize her and want to take her home with them.
episodes.title: When Does Happiness Come?

episodes.synopsis: Ken will fight his first tag team match alongside Tiger Man. The young man is going through a happy period, but Mr. X returns to haunt him.
episodes.title: An Oath for Victory

episodes.synopsis: Mister X is increasingly determined to eliminate Tiger Man in order to save his own life. For this reason, he decides to no longer limit himself in choosing fighters.
episodes.title: The Hunter of Death

episodes.synopsis: Tiger invites the children and Ruriko to his next match. His opponent this time is very unusual, as he has a split personality.
episodes.title: Jekyll and Hyde

episodes.synopsis: Mister X is becoming increasingly agitated due to his continuous failures. Meanwhile, Naoto has to worry about little Gaboten, who has been taken away by the police.
episodes.title: The Tiger Hunting Plan

episodes.synopsis: Mister X, now at his limit, wants to eliminate Tiger before the leader of Tiger's Den arrives in Japan, to avoid his wrath.
episodes.title: Scaffold with Fire

episodes.synopsis: Naoto takes a day off and decides to spend it at Ruriko's orphanage. There, he discovers that a family wants to adopt little Yoshibo.
episodes.title: Happiness of Yoshi-bo

episodes.synopsis: Mister X travels to America in search of new talent to recruit and unleash against Tiger Man. He eventually finds someone interested in his offer.
episodes.title: The Uncrowned Champ

episodes.synopsis: The leader of Tiger's Den arrives in Japan and contemplates returning to the ring to face Tiger Man. Meanwhile, he has brought a new opponent with him.
episodes.title: Devilish Spider Nest

episodes.synopsis: The leader of Tiger's Den decides to join the Japanese Federation. Here he takes on the identity of Mistero Nero and asks to face only foreign wrestlers.
episodes.title: Suspicion of the Mysterious Man

episodes.synopsis: Mistero Nero proves increasingly difficult to defeat and continues to beat his opponents with extreme ease.
episodes.title: For Today's Life

episodes.synopsis: Naoto's next opponents have been announced, but Mistero Nero is still not among them. What could the leader of Tana delle Tigri have in mind?
episodes.title: The Substitute of Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man will fight for the first time in a ring completely surrounded by water. His opponent is the fearsome Piranha.
episodes.title: The Piranhan

episodes.synopsis: Kenta wants to discover Tiger Man's identity at all costs and believes he can find out from Ken. For this reason, he tries to trap him.
episodes.title: Who Is Tiger Mask?

episodes.synopsis: Technique, speed, and strength. Mistero Nero seems to have no weaknesses and continues to defeat opponents with great ease.
episodes.title: Presentiment of Defeat

episodes.synopsis: Tiger Man is increasingly troubled by thoughts of Mistero Nero. Meanwhile, Kenta gets involved in a fight with three young bullies.
episodes.title: The Desperate Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Tana delle Tigri sends another fighter to battle Tiger Man: Lupo Solitario. For Mistero Nero, this is another opportunity to study Naoto's techniques.
episodes.title: Howl for Blood, Wolf!

episodes.synopsis: A man arrives at the orphanage claiming to be Yoshibo's father, but he does not reveal himself to the child. The next morning, his younger brother also shows up.
episodes.title: Create Your Own Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Mistero Nero challenges Ken to a fight. Naoto is very worried about his friend, who accepts the challenge without hesitation.
episodes.title: The Execution of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Ken is in terrible condition and also needs blood transfusions. Naoto swears revenge against the evil Great Tiger.
episodes.title: The Truth of Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Ruriko has finally discovered Tiger Man's secret. However, she is distraught because she fears that Naoto will be killed by Big Tiger.
episodes.title: The Struggle Tiger's Cave

episodes.synopsis: Naoto learns of Mister X's death from the newspaper. Now, Big Tiger is the last remaining member of Tiger's Den, as well as her upcoming opponent.
episodes.title: The Bloody Battle with Tiger's Cave!

episodes.synopsis: The match between Tiger Man and Great Tiger is extremely violent. The evil wrestler uses every means possible to defeat his opponent. Will Naoto manage to win again this time?
episodes.title: Tiger Mask Goes Away
